Appreciate the clear asks. Attached is a first-pass MAP (Redwood_MAP_Stratus_v1.pdf) and a pilot SOW (SOW_Stratus_Draft.docx). Key proposal highlights:

- Evaluation: 6 weeks, primary success criteria are latency <= 120ms P95 for 512-token calls and embedding accuracy measured on your 200-sample eval set (we'll help run).
- Pilot capacity: dedicated 1.5k tokens/sec burstable, with autoscale to handle spikes — test harness included.
- Commercial cadence: 30-day pilot (weeks 1–4) followed by staged commit (see milestones):
  • Milestone A (end of week 2): acceptance of integration tests — 10% committed monthly credit for next 3 months
  • Milestone B (end of week 4): performance SLA met on sample traffic — additional 20% committed credit and pricing tier move to "Committed-1" (5% unit price discount)
  • Milestone C (end of week 6): readiness for production pilot — ramp plan and annual commit discussion; we propose a graded discount schedule up to 18% at a $1.2M ARR commit.
- Renewal/expansion triggers: uplift negotiation to be tied to actual throughput; if usage exceeds committed ramp by >25% for 2 consecutive months, we automatically surface an expansion offer and a renewal credit calculation.

I've looped Marissa (AM) and Rishi (SE) for the technical acceptance criteria and to confirm timelines. If this looks ok, I'll update the MAP with the specific metric thresholds and DocuSign-ready SOW.

Aisha — quick technical reply. Proposed acceptance tests (we will provide a harness):

- Latency: P50/P95/P99 for 128/512/1024 token calls on your sample traffic (target P95 <= 120ms for 512).
- Stability: no more than 1% error rate (500ms+ timeout) on a 24h stress window at 1.5k tokens/sec sustained.
- Semantic quality: embedding precision/recall measured against your 200-sample labeled set; target F1 >= 0.82 for top-5 rerank.

On the test harness: we'll run an A/B of quantized model vs float baseline to ensure quality lift encodings are within tolerance. I'll attach the harness instructions and a sample script in the next iteration.

From a commercial standpoint, both paths are workable. If Stratus wants a compressed 5-week evaluation, we'd suggest pulling Milestone A into week 1 (integration smoke) and combining B/C into weeks 3–5 — that shifts risk but we can increase an initial credit to 12% if they sign a 9-month ramp commit (min $600k). That maps to your procurement ask.
